reason: Memory: tests/test_resampling.py hard-codes n=10,000 float64 samples and builds several 10,000 x 10,000 arrays (about 0.8 GB each). The environment manager ran it through the guarded launcher: whole file killed by the 1200 MB scope limit; per test at 1900 MB, test_diffres_versions passed and 5 tests were OOM-killed; the remaining tests were refused for low free memory. The file has no size parameter. A safe run would need a limit of 3 GB or more, which on this 7.5 GB WSL host (two WSL freezes on 2026-10-02) is not permitted. Resampling references come instead from demos/gaussian_mixture.ipynb (n=1024) and single-seed runs of experiments/gms/{diffusion,baselines,soft,gumbel}.py at nsamples=1000; independent verifiers compare wrappers with direct upstream calls.
